name: vanilla_inline_call_operands
title: Authored grouped call operands retain vanilla outer expressions

steps.query:
Begin Function { }
PrintC "nvf inline ordinary distance %g" (player.GetDistance player)
SetFunctionValue (player.GetDistance player)
End
steps.label: ordinary.self-distance

steps.query:
Begin Function { }
if player.GetDistance (player) == 0
PrintC "nvf inline grouped receiver 1"
SetFunctionValue 1
else
PrintC "nvf inline grouped receiver 0"
SetFunctionValue 0
endif
End
steps.label: grouped.receiver-condition

steps.query:
float result
Begin Function { }
set result to 100 - player.GetDistance (player) - 2
PrintC "nvf inline grouped set %g" result
SetFunctionValue result
End
steps.label: grouped.set-arithmetic

steps.query:
Begin Function { }
if 0 && 1 || player.GetDistance (player) == 0
PrintC "nvf inline mixed precedence 10"
SetFunctionValue 10
else
PrintC "nvf inline mixed precedence 20"
SetFunctionValue 20
endif
End
steps.label: grouped.outer-vanilla-precedence

steps.query:
ref ownedFunction
float answer
Begin Function { }
let ownedFunction := CompileScript "NVFInlineOperands\owned_self_distance.gek" 1
if ownedFunction == 0
PrintC "nvf inline compiled call missing"
SetFunctionValue -999
else
let answer := Call ownedFunction
PrintC "nvf inline compiled call %g" answer
SetFunctionValue answer
endif
End
steps.label: grouped.compiled-file-call
